risks.risk: Model mismatch risk (could be a different Yamaha model than PSR-175), which changes the correct market price.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the model label/serial plate (usually on the back or underside) showing 'PSR-175' clearly, plus a photo of the full front panel where the model name is readable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case comparable among the provided Yamaha keyboard listings (treat as not confirmed PSR-175).

risks.risk: Not actually working / intermittent keys or sound (seller claims 'working perfectly' but no test is shown).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: power on + screen on, play 2-3 keys across the keyboard, show volume working, and demonstrate sound through the built-in speakers or headphone output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / needs service (worst-case for 'works' claims).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, stand) affecting buyer value.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo list of included items: charger/power cable, sustain pedal, stand, and any manuals/boxes.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the keyboard is included (no accessories).

risks.risk: Physical defects not visible (cracked casing, damaged speaker, stuck keys).
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of: both speaker grilles, keybed surface, and corners/edges; plus a video showing all keys pressed once.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end of the comparable range.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the model label/serial plate showing 'PSR-175' clearly (back/underside).
Short power-on + sound test video (screen on, play across keys, confirm audio through speakers/headphones).
Photos of included accessories (power adapter/cable, sustain pedal, stand if any).
Close-ups of speakers, keybed, and corners/edges for damage.
response.reason: The seller claims PSR-175 and 'working perfectly', but the provided photo does not clearly show the model number or any working test. Without that, a worst-case price cannot be chosen confidently from the comparables.
